Troubleshooting · 18/50 · audio

Programme loudness outside target

Failure signal

A programme loudness outside target condition is reported or detected during audio.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for audio does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Measure integrated loudness, range and gating using the delivery standard.

Corrective action

Adjust the mix, remeasure the complete programme and retain the meter report.

Prevention

Add this verification to the audio gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
